groups.saying_opens: إن الله تبارك وتعالى خلق العرش

notes: Ma'mun's question («سَأَلَ مَأْمُونٌ») is in the scene only, not a link (rule 6). The Imam speaks in the story, so he is the last link of saying 1 (owner ruling 5).

Saying 2 is the Prophet's words the Imam relays with his own chain («حَدَّثَنِي أَبِي مُوسَى بْنُ جَعْفَرٍ...»), stored as its own group (rule 4a). The Imam's own «حدثني» is not written as a link in that group.
The later answers (غطاء العين) continue the same chain: no new isnad, so part of saying 1.
